mapper.select: SELECT id, email, name, role, oauth_provider as oauthProvider, oauth_id as oauthId, phone_number as phoneNumber, created_at as createdAt, last_login as lastLogin FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( id, email, name, role, oauth_provider, oauth_id, phone_number, created_at, last_login ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{email}, #{name}, #{role}, #{oauthProvider}, #{oauthId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{createdAt}, #{lastLogin} )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, role = #{role}, oauth_provider = #{oauthProvider}, oauth_id = #{oauthId}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, created_at = #{createdAt}, last_login = #{lastLogin} WHERE id = #{id}
